content.comment_body: Greetings everyone. I run a small laundry business and I'm working on programming controller boards for washing machines using [product_name]. Previously, I used Micrologix for programming, but now I'm working with [product_name] [version_no]. Attached is a summary of a routine for commercial washing timer controls. The logic repeats with varying timing values. I also included a basic control routine for both low-speed washing and high-speed extraction, as I find ladder logic easier to grasp (I am 39, and some say older people struggle to learn new approaches). No output or safety conditions have been set up yet. I need help because although I have a control routine worked out in Micrologix, I'm struggling to convert this to [product_name]. Thank you for your support. Good night.
Unfortunately, it's difficult for me to understand your programming without a clear functional description. Additionally, the comments in your program are written in a language I don't understand.

Hello [user_name], Language differences pose a significant challenge—not only with natural language but also with PLC code. [product_name] is generally more suited to programming in FBD. If possible, could you share a PDF printout of your Micrologix code? (Also, is there a reason you're not continuing with Micrologix?) For reference, another user submitted a program for a washing machine which you may find useful. Using the forum's search might help you locate it.
Could you add more comments in your program for clarity? Please refer to the example provided.

Thank you for your feedback. I will take time to rewrite the program in English. Apologies—as mentioned earlier, I learned ladder logic programming at university from 2001-2006, which is why it's easier for me, but I'll try to improve and accept the challenge. I appreciate everyone's interest!
[user_name]: Take a look at the sample code provided by [user_name]. This might assist with setting up a timed sequence.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is shifting from Micrologix to [product_name] [version_no] to develop control routines for washing machines. The primary challenge lies in converting ladder logic experience and existing code from their previous PLC platform to the new [company_name] environment, which recommends FBD programming. Both language differences in code and natural language create additional barriers in sharing and receiving help. The community suggests sample codes and forum resources, but the lack of clear functional explanations and language gaps make progress slower.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a simple way to translate ladder logic routines from Micrologix PLCs to [product_name] [version_no], and is looking for clear, easily accessible programming examples that fit their background. They wish for guidance in English to help improve their code clarity and documentation.
